title: Pair correlation and squared convolution
statement: Let $\phi$ be a nonnegative function on $�\mathbb{F}_2^n$ with uniform expectation $1$, and let $F:\mathbb{F}_2^n\to\mathbb{R}$ be any function. The average, first over $y$ with density $\phi$ and then over $y'$ with density $\phi$, of the uniform average of $F(x+y)F(x+y')$ equals the uniform average of the square of the convolution of $\phi$ and $F$.
